benefits.name: Account Anniversary Avios Bonus
benefits.description: 2,500 bonus Avios awarded each account anniversary year.
benefits.terms: Flat 2,500 Avios credited automatically each cardmember anniversary year, not a spend-based multiplier.

benefits.name: Reward Flight Statement Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit to help offset taxes, fees, and carrier-imposed charges on eligible British Airways Reward Flight bookings.
benefits.terms: $100 per booking for Economy/Premium Economy, $200 per booking for Business/First, up to 3 bookings and $600 total per calendar year. Reward Flight must be a transatlantic international itinerary originating in the U.S. solely on British Airways-operated aircraft.

benefits.name: Travel Together Ticket
benefits.description: A companion voucher earned annually upon reaching $30,000 in purchases within a calendar year, valid for 2 years on British Airways, Iberia, or Aer Lingus.
benefits.terms: Requires $30,000 in calendar-year purchases. Provides either a free companion seat on a Reward Flight (taxes/fees still apply) or a 50% Avios reduction for solo Reward Flight redemption. Voucher valid for 2 years from issuance.

benefits.name: 10% Flight Discount
benefits.description: 10% off British Airways flights originating in the U.S. when booked through the designated cardholder booking link.
benefits.terms: Must book through the website provided in welcome materials.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: One year of complimentary DashPass membership from DoorDash, plus a quarterly non-restaurant discount.
benefits.terms: Membership auto-renews at the then-current rate after the complimentary year. Also includes up to $10 off quarterly on non-restaurant DoorDash orders. Requires activation.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed 6+ hours.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $500 per item.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less by an additional year, up to 4 years total.

earningRates.terms: Flight purchases made directly with British Airways, Aer Lingus, Iberia, and LEVEL. Earned as Avios.
Hotel accommodations purchased directly with the hotel. Earned as Avios.
